views.name: customer_summary
views.description: Per-customer order counts, fulfilled order value, segment, and most recent order timestamp.

columns.name: customer_id
columns.description: Internal identifier of the summarized customer.

columns.name: first_name
columns.description: Customer given name.

columns.name: last_name
columns.description: Customer family name.

columns.name: segment
columns.description: Commercial customer grouping.

columns.name: completed_or_open_orders
columns.description: Count of the customer orders whose status is not cancelled.

columns.name: fulfilled_order_value
columns.description: Sum of line totals including tax for shipped or delivered orders; excludes cancelled and open orders.

columns.name: most_recent_order_at
columns.description: Timestamp of the latest order of any status for the customer.

views.definition:
SELECT c.customer_id,
    c.first_name,
    c.last_name,
    c.segment,
    count(DISTINCT o.order_id) FILTER (WHERE (o.status <> 'cancelled'::text)) AS completed_or_open_orders,
    (COALESCE(sum(ot.total) FILTER (WHERE (o.status = ANY (ARRAY['shipped'::text, 'delivered'::text]))), (0)::numeric))::numeric(14,2) AS fulfilled_order_value,
    max(o.ordered_at) AS most_recent_order_at
   FROM ((retail.customers c
     LEFT JOIN retail.orders o USING (customer_id))
     LEFT JOIN retail.order_totals ot USING (order_id))
  GROUP BY c.customer_id;

views.name: monthly_sales
views.description: Monthly shipped and delivered sales summarized by product category, including orders, units, and net sales before tax.

columns.name: sales_month
columns.description: First calendar day of the sales month.

columns.name: category_id
columns.description: Product category identifier used to group sales.

columns.name: category_name
columns.description: Human-readable product category used to group sales.

columns.name: order_count
columns.description: Distinct shipped or delivered orders containing this category in the month.

columns.name: units_sold
columns.description: Units sold in shipped or delivered orders for the category and month.

columns.name: net_sales_before_tax
columns.description: Line sales after line discounts and before tax for shipped or delivered orders.

views.definition:
SELECT (date_trunc('month'::text, o.ordered_at))::date AS sales_month,
    p.category_id,
    c.category_name,
    count(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count,
    sum(oi.quantity) AS units_sold,
    (sum((((oi.quantity)::numeric * oi.unit_price) * ((1)::numeric - oi.discount_pct))))::numeric(14,2) AS net_sales_before_tax
   FROM (((retail.orders o
     JOIN retail.order_items oi USING (order_id))
     JOIN retail.products p USING (product_id))
     JOIN retail.categories c USING (category_id))
  WHERE (o.status = ANY (ARRAY['shipped'::text, 'delivered'::text]))
  GROUP BY ((date_trunc('month'::text, o.ordered_at))::date), p.category_id, c.category_name;

views.name: order_totals
views.description: Per-order monetary summary derived from order lines, including subtotal, line discounts, tax, and total.

columns.name: order_id
columns.description: Internal identifier of the order summarized by this view.

columns.name: order_number
columns.description: Customer-facing order reference.

columns.name: customer_id
columns.description: Customer who placed the order.

columns.name: ordered_at
columns.description: Timestamp when the order was placed.

columns.name: status
columns.description: Current order lifecycle state.

columns.name: subtotal
columns.description: Sum of line quantity times captured unit price before discounts and tax.

columns.name: line_discounts
columns.description: Total line-item discount amount before tax; promotion mappings are not additionally deducted.

columns.name: tax
columns.description: Tax summed across order lines after each line-level discount.

columns.name: total
columns.description: Order line total after line discounts and tax; excludes shipping charges.

views.definition:
SELECT o.order_id,
    o.order_number,
    o.customer_id,
    o.ordered_at,
    o.status,
    (sum(((oi.quantity)::numeric * oi.unit_price)))::numeric(12,2) AS subtotal,
    (sum((((oi.quantity)::numeric * oi.unit_price) * oi.discount_pct)))::numeric(12,2) AS line_discounts,
    (sum(((((oi.quantity)::numeric * oi.unit_price) * ((1)::numeric - oi.discount_pct)) * oi.tax_rate)))::numeric(12,2) AS tax,
    (sum(((((oi.quantity)::numeric * oi.unit_price) * ((1)::numeric - oi.discount_pct)) * ((1)::numeric + oi.tax_rate))))::numeric(12,2) AS total
   FROM (retail.orders o
     JOIN retail.order_items oi USING (order_id))
  GROUP BY o.order_id;
